scope: Synthetic geometry evidence, not official simulator performance

design.note: Grid medians describe this deterministic design only; no probability model is assumed. All synthetic replies use legal two-decimal returned angles; requested bias is rounded inward if needed to preserve +/-1 degrees.
design.geometry: Target disk plus +/-1 degree wedges plus 1500 m reception disks; conservative near-zone enclosure

q2_refinement.method: 25 m local grid within +/-100 m of coarse winners; best continuous bound among five sample finalists per budget. No global-optimality claim.

dense_design.note: Unweighted deterministic scenario medians, not expected performance or success probabilities.
